experiment: Madden 27 ratings in the TAK/BTK tackle-hold model

sourceSnapshot.source: EA SPORTS official player ratings database

mapping.ELU: retained from the Gridiron public-research estimate because Madden 27 does not expose an ELU attribute

matchup.scenario: NE at CHI, run up the middle, frozen Week 7 roster snapshot
matchup.note: Madden 27 has no ELU field. Project ELU is retained; official BTK=81 exceeds estimated ELU=76 and therefore controls max(BTK, ELU).

interpretationLimit: Matched seeds share the same play IDs, but changed trajectories can consume random draws differently. This is a mechanism probe, not validation against tracked tackle outcomes.
